label: AB11C3D_mC128_15_f_ae10f_3f_f-001
title: MoP$_{3}$SiO$_{11}$ (Monoclinic Model) Structure
comments: (Leclaire, 1987) originally proposed that MoP$_{3}$SiO$_{11}$ was in \href{current_web_home_dir/AB11C3D_mC128_15_f_ae10f_3f_f-001}{the monoclinic structure shown here}.  Later, (Badrtdinov, 2021) placed the compound in the \href{current_web_home_dir/AB11C3D_hR64_167_c_be3f_f_c-001}{rhombohedral $R\overline{3}c$ \#167 space group}.  When we allow a 0.1{\AA} uncertainty in the atomic positions the monoclinic structure reduces to the rhombohedral structure.  Given this ambiguity we retain both structures in the library.
